b2-32-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Saving Money
b2-32-01.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks whether you manage to save money each month. You do: you always have something left.
b2-32-01.prompt: Tell Carlos that something is left, however little you save.
cues: Say you will have something left
b2-32-01.target: Por poco que ahorres, algo te quedará.
b2-32-01.english: However little you save, you will have something left.
b2-32-01.canDo: I can use *por poco que* for "however little".

b2-32-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Telling the Truth
b2-32-02.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks whether you will tell a friend the truth. You will, and you know you could lose the friend.
b2-32-02.prompt: Tell Meg you will say it, and what you risk.
cues: Say you will tell the truth
Say the risk, with an expression for 'even at the risk of'
b2-32-02.target: Voy a decírselo, aun a riesgo de perder a un amigo.
b2-32-02.english: I am going to tell him, even at the risk of losing a friend.
b2-32-02.canDo: I can use *aun a riesgo de* with an infinitive or with *que* + subjunctive.

b2-32-03.title: Communicative Challenge: A Firm Decision
b2-32-03.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos says his boss thinks the plan is not possible. You are going to try anyway.
b2-32-03.prompt: Tell Carlos that you will try, whatever the boss says.
cues: Say you are going to try
b2-32-03.target: Diga lo que diga, vamos a intentarlo.
b2-32-03.english: Whatever he says, we are going to try.
b2-32-03.canDo: I can use *cueste lo que cueste*, *pase lo que pase* and *diga lo que diga*.

b2-32-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Making Coffee
b2-32-04.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks how you want him to make the coffee. You do not mind how.
b2-32-04.prompt: Tell Carlos he can make it however he likes.
cues: Say he can make it however he likes
Say it is all the same to you
b2-32-04.target: Prepara el café como quieras; me da igual.
b2-32-04.english: Make the coffee however you like; it is all the same to me.
b2-32-04.canDo: I can use *como* + verb for "the way" and "however".

b2-32-05.title: Communicative Challenge: A Warm Greeting
b2-32-05.scenario: You are Meg. Carlos asks about the new neighbour. He greeted you in a friendly way, although you had never met.
b2-32-05.prompt: Tell Carlos how the neighbour spoke to you.
cues: Compare it with something imagined, with 'as if'
b2-32-05.target: Me habló como si me conociera.
b2-32-05.english: He spoke to me as if he knew me.
b2-32-05.canDo: I can use *como si* + imperfect subjunctive for something imagined.

b2-32-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Doing It Your Way
b2-32-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. Meg asks how you will do the homework. You will do it as it seems best to you.
b2-32-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg how you will do it.
cues: Say you will do the homework
Say you will choose how, as it seems best to you
b2-32-consolidation.target: Voy a hacer la tarea según me parezca mejor.
b2-32-consolidation.english: I am going to do the homework as seems best to me.
b2-32-consolidation.canDo: I can read a short text about Rómulo Gallegos and his novel.
